questions.text: Whose company is Leila expecting at the seed-swap?
questions.expectedAnswer: Nikhil, as explicitly named by Leila; the unidentified speaker must not be assigned to either named participant.

questions.text: What clock time can safely go on the seed-swap calendar entry?
questions.expectedAnswer: The date is 2027-02-16, but 7 AM versus 7 PM is unresolved. Ask which one; do not silently choose 07:00 or 19:00 and do not execute an action.

questions.text: What is the name of the person who offered the blue seed tin?
questions.expectedAnswer: Unknown. The offer is attributed only to unknown, not Leila or Nikhil.
